value.name: arrive at office early
value.description: She arrives at the office earlier than usual and earlier than she had planned to, despite a full day of obligations ahead.
evidence: She arrived at the office at seven-forty, which was earlier than she usually arrived and earlier than she had told herself she would arrive

value.name: make coffee
value.description: She makes coffee in the office kitchen as part of settling into the day.
evidence: and she made coffee in the small kitchen

value.name: reflect at office window
value.description: She stands at her office window looking out at the neighboring brick building, which triggers a comparison to the Serrano house.
evidence: and stood at the window of her office looking at the brick of the building opposite, which was not the brick of the Serrano house but resembled it

value.name: review task list
value.description: She looks over the seven-item list she made the night before, taking stock of her pending work and personal concerns.
evidence: She had made, the night before, a list.
The list was on a yellow pad on her desk and it had seven items on it

value.name: confront neutrality note
value.description: She stares at the underlined word 'neutrality,' then crosses it out and replaces it with a reminder about why she does the work.
evidence: the seventh, written in smaller handwriting and underlined twice, was the single word "neutrality."
She looked at the seventh item for some time and then she crossed it out
She wrote in its place, in the same small handwriting, "remember why you do this work."

value.name: call Marcus
value.description: She begins her workday by calling Marcus.

value.name: learn Marcus filed codicil
value.description: The call reveals that Marcus has already filed the codicil, confirming progress on the matter.
evidence: Marcus had filed the codicil on T
